name: BBTool
description: Bollinger Bands - volatility indicator with upper/lower bands based on standard deviations. Price touching bands may indicate overbought/oversold conditions or breakouts.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: Period (SMA)
fields.description: Period for the middle band SMA. Standard value is 20 periods.

fields.label: Standard Deviation Multiplier
fields.description: Number of standard deviations for upper/lower bands. Standard is 2. Higher values create wider bands.
